# Attachment

# Objective 1: To describe the socio-demogprahic profile of the respondents

# Objective 2: To measure the level of awareness of the Baybayanons.

## Awareness

### Rice-based delicacies

```{r}
p_aware_rice <- 
    aware_rice_based_dta |> 
    ggplot(aes(pct, delicacy, fill = rate_lab)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = pct_lab), position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#073b4c", "#118ab2", "#06d6a0", "#ffba66ff", "#e63946")) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
    custom_theme +
    labs(
    title = str_wrap("Perceived level of awareness on rice-based delicacies.", 40),
    fill =  NULL,
    y = NULL,
    x = NULL
    )

ggsave(
    plot = p_aware_rice,
    filename = "plot/aware_rice.jpg",
    dpi = 400,
    unit = "in",
    width = 8,
    height = 6
)

knitr::include_graphics("plot/aware_rice.jpg")

```

# Objective 3: To measure the resident's perception of local delicacies in terms of product marketability, cuisine prepservation.

# Objective 4: To assess the residents' willingness to support towards gastronomic tourism.

## Proportion of resident willing to participate

```{r}
p_activity_part <- 
    activity_part_dta |> 
    mutate(activity = str_wrap(activity, 30)) |> 
    mutate(activity = fct_reorder(activity, pct)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(pct, activity, fill = activity)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, show.legend = F) +
    geom_text(aes(label = pct_lab), hjust = -0.1) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.20), labels = percent_format()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#e0e1dd", "#778da9", "#415a77", "#1b263b", "#0d1b2a")) +
    labs(
        title = str_wrap("Proportion of residents who are willing to participate on gastronomic tourism activities", 50),
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL
    ) +
    custom_theme


ggsave(
    plot = p_activity_part,
    filename = "plot/activity_participate.jpg",
    dpi = 400,
    unit = "in",
    width = 8,
    height = 5
)

knitr::include_graphics("plot/activity_participate.jpg")
```


## Recommend Baybay local delicacies

```{r}
p_reco_local_delicacy <- 
    reco_local_delicacy_dta |> 
    mutate(recommend = fct_reorder(recommend, pct)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(pct, recommend, fill = recommend)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, show.legend = F) +
    geom_text(aes(label = pct_lab), hjust = -0.1) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.20), labels = percent_format()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c( "#415a77", "#1b263b", "#0d1b2a")) +
    labs(
        title = str_wrap("Would you like to recommend Baybay's local food to tourists?", 50),
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL
    ) +
    custom_theme

ggsave(
    plot = p_reco_local_delicacy,
    filename = "plot/reco_local_delicacy.jpg",
    dpi = 400,
    unit = "in",
    width = 8,
    height = 5
)

knitr::include_graphics("plot/reco_local_delicacy.jpg")
```
